description: Add a registered company (state and number from search_companies) to the account's watchlist. It is re-checked daily; changes in status, standing, registered agent, address, people of record, filings, UCC liens, licenses, permits and sanctions/PEP matches are POSTed to the account's webhook, listed by watchlist_events and sent in a daily email digest. Needs a Build (100 companies) or Growth (1,000) plan.
name: watch_company
title: Monitor a company
